name: The First Encounter
message:
As you sleep, you find yourself dreaming of a vast, blue skyscape that stretches in all directions around you.  Four strange figures, shrouded in either red or black float in a slow circle around, humming in a way that vibrates your very being.  Despite this, you feel safe.  At peace.

When you wake up, you find in your hand a single gold coin, warm to the touch.

It makes you really feel like gambling.
